req_a.text: The system shall verify communication between subsystems.

req_b.text: The subsystem shall have checks to mitigate the chances of a cybersecurity attack.

req_a.text: The system shall not irritate the driver with more than 3 updates or alerts in 10 minutes for the system.

req_b.text: The system shall alert the driver if any malfunctions or errors have been detected within 5 seconds.

req_a.text: The ADB system shall activate high beams automatically when vehicle speed exceeds 40 km/h and ambient lighting is below 10 lux.

req_b.text: The system shall log all lighting state transitions and sensor diagnostic flags to persistent memory.

req_a.text: The system shall include the Brake Control Subsystem (BCS).

req_b.text: The system shall log all lighting state transitions and sensor diagnostic flags to persistent memory.
The system shall alert the driver if any malfunctions or errors have been detected within 5 seconds.

req_a.text: The system shall always stop the vehicle to prevent collision with objects during the parking maneuver.

req_b.text: The system shall abort the automatic parking procedure immediately if an unexpected obstacle enters the trajectory boundary within 0.5 meters.

req_a.text: The APA system shall signal completion of the parking maneuver via audio chime and electronic park brake activation.

req_b.text: The APA system shall support both parallel parking and perpendicular reverse parking modes.

req_a.text: The TJA system shall control longitudinal acceleration and deceleration based on front radar target distance.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall bring the vehicle to a full stop when the preceding vehicle stops.

req_a.text: The TJA system shall require active engagement of the driver hand-on-wheel sensor every 15 seconds.

req_b.text: The TJA system shall maintain a user-selected headway time gap of 1.0s, 1.5s, or 2.0s to the preceding vehicle.
